physics: Gazebo Fortress motor_pd; fresh world per attempt
sequence: WBC baseAccel weights1,1.5,2 with fixed joint PD60/60/90,Kd2 at forward/backward1m/s plus baseline +/-0.5m/s
At weight1.5 change only joint Kp to45/45/65 keeping Kd2, then only Kd to2.5
After no parameter candidate passed all criteria, add optional spherical-foot rolling velocity model to the estimator only
Rebuild, run all26 CTest groups, then repeat weight1,Kp60/60/90,Kd2 with rolling radius0 and.026m, forward/backward1m/s

build_and_tests.build: Release incremental build; real hardware OFF; tests ON

decision.reason: No new configuration demonstrated balanced improvement in speed, height and foot tracking while passing the unchanged original acceptance and nominal total-torque checks. No new formal foot-error threshold was introduced. Rolling compensation reduces estimation bias, but actual speed decreases, height remains below target, and off-axis tracking still fails. It remains opt-in.

semantics_and_limits: Velocity/height use independent simulation truth, not controller estimates. Common-window velocity is pose finite difference rotated into body axes, with sample-time weighting.

Foot error is exported joint-reference vs measured-joint body-frame FK during planned swing; includes delay, not absolute world foot placement or measured contact. World foot errors in the raw report also include estimator odometry drift.

Torque means delayed motor-PD FF+PD request before passive friction, not measured hardware torque/current/thermal capability. Peak uses physical cumulative statistics; the final unprinted tail is checked separately with sampled effort. Excursion counts are joint samples, not elapsed milliseconds.
Weights multiply task A and b before squared cost; weights1/1.5/2 mean squared coefficients1/2.25/4.

Rolling estimation assumes a rigid no-slip spherical sole on flat ground; uses only IMU, joint kinematics and radius. It updates velocity observations and foot-position prediction; explicit ContactSupport remains authoritative.
Planned contact delay/ramp covariance is preserved; rolling is generated for planned stance even before full trust. There are no sole contact sensors or measured contact forces.

NMPC/WBC point-contact constraints and the default FF-only WBC torque model remain unchanged. Strict q/dq integrability and delayed execution total-torque guarantees are not fixed by this estimator patch.
Each profile/direction has one trial in this sweep; rolling-off repeats the original baseline after rebuilding. Millimeter differences do not establish statistical significance.
No hardware movement, board real-time acceptance or calibrated actuator/friction model is established.

tracking_failures: governed reference differs from command by 0.007; reference lead limiter remains enabled
